name: Shree Manjunatha Engineering Works
address: 24/2, near Basaveshwara Temple, Kuppalur, Mysuru, Karnataka 570031
hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM. Sundays: site visits only.
service_area: Mysuru and nearby areas only. Confirm unfamiliar nearby places with Prashanth; do not assume all Karnataka is served.

materials.MS: Strong and affordable; periodic repainting helps prevent rust. Used for gates, grills, shutters and compound walls.
materials.SS: Rust-resistant; usually requires no painting; costs more. Used for railings, balconies and high-moisture areas.

finishing: One coat of yellow oxide anti-rust primer. Powder coating and spray painting are not offered. For other finishes, ask Prashanth.
pricing_policy: Never provide numerical prices, rates, ranges or estimates. Price depends on size, material and design. Site visit is free. Quotation is shared after the visit, not on the spot.
invoice_policy: Standard quotations only; GST and tax invoices are not available. Answer honestly if explicitly asked.
custom_designs: Accepts photos, Pinterest references and sketches via WhatsApp.
after_sales: Contact Prashanth directly for concerns after installation.
never_promise: A confirmed appointment without human confirmation
